name: Tacos de Papa

ingredients.name: russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch cubes
chipotle chilis, canned in adobo sauce
fresh tortillas, kept warm in a clean dish towel

instructions.primary_message: Place potatoes and 1 tablespoon salt in a medium saucepan and cover with water by 2.5-cm. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce to a simmer and simmer until potatoes fully tender and just starting to break down, about 5 minutes. Drain and transfer to a medium bowl.

Meanwhile, add oil, onion, and garlic to a heavy-bottomed 30-cm skillet and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until onions and garlic are fully softened but have not taken on any color, about 6 minutes. Add pickled jalapeño, chopped chipotles, and adobo sauce. Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce begins to fry, about 1 minute. Add potatoes, capers, and cream and stir to combine, mashing potatoes slightly. Season to taste with salt and transfer to serving bowl.

To serve, bring potato mixture, scallions, cotija, salsa, lime wedges, and hot tortillas to the table. Each taco should be made by stacking two tortillas, adding a small amount of the potato mixture, and topping as desired.

schema_metadata.keywords: capers, chipotle, cotija cheese, potatoes, salsa, scallions, tortillas

description: Proof that starch-on-starch is just as delicious in taco form.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Salsa of your choice

Optional substitutions: Mexican crema → ⅓ cup sour cream thinned with 1 tablespoon milk
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
